readings: Using every playlist in the Playlist table, including playlists with zero tracks, compute the average number of tracks per playlist. Then return the 10 playlists with the highest track counts. For each, show the playlist id, its track count, and the unrounded ratio of that count to the average. Sort by ratio from highest to lowest, with any missing ratios last.

Using only playlists that have at least one row in PlaylistTrack, so empty playlists are excluded, compute the average number of tracks per playlist. Then return the 10 playlists with the highest track counts. For each, show the playlist id, its track count, and the unrounded ratio of that count to the average. Sort by ratio from highest to lowest, with any missing ratios last.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Playlist p
  LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
  GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
avg_c AS (
  SELECT AVG(track_count * 1.0) AS avg_count FROM counts
)
SELECT c.PlaylistId,
       c.track_count,
       CASE WHEN a.avg_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE c.track_count * 1.0 / a.avg_count END AS ratio
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN avg_c a
ORDER BY c.track_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY PlaylistId
),
avg_c AS (
  SELECT AVG(track_count * 1.0) AS avg_count FROM counts
)
SELECT c.PlaylistId,
       c.track_count,
       c.track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.avg_count, 0) AS ratio
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN avg_c a
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
